text: Patient ko 6 mahine se haath pair mein sujan hai aur walking mushkil ho gayi hai.
Bacha chhattis mahine ka hai, abhi tak bolna nahi seekha, doctor ne developmental delay bataya.
Peeli aankhein aur piliya do hafte se hai, liver functions disturb hain.
Kamzori badh rahi hai, pair uthane ke liye haath lagana padta hai.
Raat mein na dikhna shuru hua hai, night blindness ka shak hai.
Maa bhi kamzori se pareshan hain, parivaar mein do cousins ko anemia tha.
Mirgi ka daura mahine mein do baar aata hai, carbamazepine de rakhi hai.
Hemoglobin 6.5 hai, khoon ki kami ki wajah se transfusion har mahine.
Chalne mein dikkat, pairon mein jhanjhanahat, neurologist se mila.
Papa ko bhi same symptoms the, paternal uncle ki beti ko bhi fits.
Tili ka badhna aur jaundice repeat ho raha hai, spleen 8 cm below costal margin.
Sunai kam ho gayi hai dono kaano mein, school teacher ne notice kiya.
Haath kaanpna table par khaana le jaate samay zyada hota hai.
Barah saal ka larka hai par Height nahi badh rahi, yearly 2 cm only.
Vajan nahi badh raha, steatorrhea type motion, chest infections baar baar.
Naye daag peeche par aaye hain, cafe-au-lait spots six hai, ganth bhi hai.
Uthne ke liye haath lagata hai floor se, Gowers sign positive.
Doctor ne phenytoin start kiya, seizures control mein aa rahe hain.
Do saal ka bacha, hypotonia born se, head control nahi.
Khoon transfusion ke baad bhi HB 7 se upar nahi, spleen ka size badh raha hai.
Maa puchi thi ki cousin marriage hai, consanguineous shadi hui hai.
Prescription mein clopidogrel 75mg aur atorvastatin likha gaya hai.
Bachche ko baar baar khaansi bukhaar ho raha hai, antibiotics se thik hota hai phir wapas.
Eyes white nahi hain, yellowish hai do din se, urine bhi dark hai.
Sir chhota hai aur neck control 9 mahine tak nahi aaya.
